rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an animal or person leaps onto or at a target.

example.english: The cat is ready to pounce as soon as it sees the fish.
example.traditional: 隻貓一見到條魚，就撲上去。
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 jat1 gin3 dou2 tiu4 jyu4 zau6 pok3 soeng5 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for eagerly seizing an opportunity rather than physically pouncing on something.

example.english: As soon as a free trial class is available, we pounce on the opportunity and sign up.
example.traditional: 一有免費試堂，我哋就即刻捉緊機會報名。
example.jyutping: jat1 jau5 min5 fai3 si3 tong4 ngo5 dei6 zau6 zik1 hak1 zuk1 gan2 gei1 wui6 bou3 ming4
